name: Outlaw Tools v0.8.0
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.8.0

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.8.0

## Read-Only Economy And Marketplace

- Browse selected-item UEX shop/sale quotes and listing history in the new Marketplace workspace, linked from Inventory, Shopping and Refinery.
- Keep public evidence in a bounded local SQLite cache. Cached reads work offline; failed refreshes retain old data with stale labels. Network reads stay off the interface thread and respect rate limits.
- Estimate selected batches using exact prices and units. Owned stock, expected output and unpriced/disputed batches stay separate. Estimates exclude fees and do not guarantee availability or profit.
- Filter history by date and QL tier. Separate currency, unit and game-build comparisons; capped results show partial coverage. Observations are listings, not completed sales.
- Compare station bonuses and qualitative refinery methods without changing orders or inventing exact processing formulas.
- Save local favourites. Player quantities, jobs and logs stay on your PCs; favourites are installation settings and do not sync. No external listing is published.
- Dedicated Routes, reviewed listing publication and Link/Deck remain separate upcoming releases.

## Downloads

- Windows: `OutlawTools-Setup-0.8.0.exe` and SHA-256 checksum.
- Linux: `OutlawTools-linux-x86_64-0.8.0.tar.gz` and SHA-256 checksum.
